tools.name: index
tools.description: Every chapter of the guide with a summary of what it answers, its outline and its URL. Call this first, then choose chapters by their summaries.

tools.name: read
tools.description: One chapter or section of the guide, whole, with everything under it — by `id` (from index or search) or by `path` (its URL's path inside the guide). Long ones arrive in parts: pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor`.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find chapters and sections of the guide by words as written. Returns ids for `fetch`, titles and URLs; with few matches it also returns the chapters, to choose from.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: One chapter or section of the guide by the `id` search returned: its full text with everything under it, its URL, and its revision.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
